notes: Famous deterministic constructor (ALGO-CN-020). Lookup is a linear scan over a 36-entry TABLE doing case-insensitive ASCII compare; in practice it stays in L1 and the whole hit takes <1μs even with the largest dataset (Meredith 70v/140e: 5.4μs end-to-end, dominated by the bulk add_edges call). Walking the entire 31-graph catalogue costs ~50μs in release mode. The python-igraph baseline (`Graph.Famous(name)`) sits at ~85μs/call because the per-call cost is dominated by the Cython entry path and Graph object construction; Rust avoids both layers and the 31-name walk speedup tracks the per-call ratio. Capture: `cargo bench --bench bench_famous -- --quick` on Darwin/M-series release; python baseline via `.venv/bin/python -m igraph` averaged over 200 iterations. Medians (criterion middle column) reported for rust numbers.
